description: Find source-linked recent Board decisions by condition name, slug, alias or common wording. Inspects up to the 50 most recent indexed decisions per condition. A phrase like "sleep apnea secondary to PTSD" looks for decisions in both recent lists with a decision-level secondary theory. The direction of the relationship requires verification in the original decision. Results are bounded research examples. Grant rates are withheld.

conditions.description: Matches any supplied entry. Examples include "knee pain", "PTSD" and "sleep apnea secondary to PTSD". Use up to five distinct conditions in total.

name: find_similar_appeals

link.description: Tagged deep link into the matching veterans-rights.com page.
